text:
Estimated items on the tray before eating:
- Toast: 2 slices of wholemeal toast, about 70 g and 180 kcal (with a little spread, maybe 190).
- Fried egg: about 46 g and 90 kcal.
- Strawberries: about 60 g and 20 kcal.
- Mushrooms: about 60 g, roasted, and about 25 kcal.
- Grilled tomato: 2 halves, about 80 g and 20 kcal.
- Jam and marmalade: 2 portions of about 14 g each, so about 28 g and 70 kcal in total.

After eating, the jam packets look mostly used. One container still has a little residue, so I counted most of the jam as eaten.

Everything appears to have been eaten, including the egg, toast, fruit and vegetables.

Totals:
- Mass: 70 + 46 + 60 + 60 + 80 + about 25 g of jam = about 340 g.
- Energy: 190 + 90 + 20 + 25 + 20 + about 60 kcal of jam = about 405 kcal.
